Ads makes content free or cheaper. Non-intrusive ads, such as text ads, or static image ads, should be enabled by default in adblock extensions.

There are thousands of blogs and websites that depend on ad revenue. If they don't get enough revenue, they are forced to get their revenue from somewhere else. If they don't have enough time to spend on the blog/website, we won't get any new content.

There are a lot of blogs and website that abuses ads. Some do it because they don't make enough with non-intrusive ads, and some do it because they only care about revenue. They have video/sound ads next to text content, they have popup boxes that take up 1/4 of the screen, and text ads that popup in the content. They deserve to have their ads blocked, because they don't care about their readers.

Then there are blogs/sites that make an effort to make their ads as non-intrusive as possible. They only have text ads, or static image ads. These websites should be awarded.

You can support content creators that care about their readers by enabling non-intrusive ads in adblock plus. The list of websites/blogs that are allowed are check manually by the people at Adblock Plus.

  • Chrome
  • Firefox

Install it if you haven't. Then go to Adblock Plus > Options. Then, tick the box for “Allow some non-intrusive advertising” at the bottom of the “Filter lists” tab.

You can read more about it here: https://adblockplus.org/acceptable-ads

Yeah, you're right. Ethically, they should allow non-intrusive ads by default. A more interesting question is if they should even offer the option to easily block non-intrusive ads. I know that people wouldn't use a service without that capability.
